title: CIA Report Warns of Civil Conflict Risk and Potential 'Collapse' in Israel
detail: A CIA internal report reportedly warns of potential civil conflict and societal 'collapse' in Israel, reflecting US intelligence concern over domestic Israeli stability amid the prolonged multi-front war. The assessment underscores deepening fractures within Israeli society as the conflict enters its second year.
